mentions.name: Anti-spam email/messaging protocol
mentions.description: An anti-spam protocol for email and messaging that is simple and cheap to implement, directly compatible with email and messengers, free for senders, and does not require senders to pay to send a message. It aims for a lower false negative rate than current spam filtering and is future-proofed to work against AI-generated spam.
mentions.problem: People receive too much marketing spam, survey spam, and low-effort cold emails, and current spam filtering methods fail to filter them successfully, wasting recipients' time.
mentions.audience: People who receive too much marketing spam, survey spam, and low-effort cold emails and want to easily filter them out
mentions.source_excerpt: Anti-spam email/messaging protocol that is simple, cheap to implement, directly compatible with email/messengers, low false negative rate compared to current spam filtering, free for senders, and does not require the sender to pay to send a message.
